analyst_view.overall: Early view: Two European sides from the south-west. Freiburg have been the more consistent under Julian Schuster, with only ten conceded in nine, while Hoffenheim's results under Christian Ilzer have swung, from 3-0 against Leverkusen to 0-2 at Bremen with one shot on target, and they have several defenders out until December or January.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. Freiburg's tight defence pulls the total down and Hoffenheim's depleted back line pulls it up, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The site expects 9.4 corners. Freiburg dominate possession at home and cross a lot through Niklas Beste and Vincenzo Grifo, so I lean slightly higher on their share.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. Hoffenheim have been disciplined lately (one booking in their last two league games) and Freiburg average two or three, so I lean slightly lower.

shots.text: The site has 27.1 shots. Both teams take a fair number of shots, and I find nothing to move the number much either way.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 on target. Freiburg have scored a club-record number of goals for this stage and Hoffenheim's two-striker system gets shots away, so I lean slightly higher.
